• Implement a 30-day check-in call with all centres after a coach change to catch dissatisfaction early and course-correct before cancellation.

• Schedule monthly one-on-one coaching sessions with underperforming coaches focused on energy, reliability, and participant engagement—document progress or escalate to replacement.
